LLM menu selection (f905a73f821a4e36909908eed3f0da12): A regularized logistic model on character n-grams is a strong, robust first real baseline for high-dimensional sparse text and directly addresses the dummy model's chance-level evidence. The balanced class weight matches the nearly even class counts, while the char analyzer can capture subword and morphological patterns without relying on external tools or test data. This experiment is preferable before deeper XGBoost variants because it is simpler and gives clearer evidence about whether the text representation carries signal.
